scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run format:check
scripts.demo:build: npm run validate:content && node scripts/demo.mjs build
scripts.demo:review: npm run validate:content && node scripts/demo.mjs review
scripts.test:layout: docker run --rm --ipc=host --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --config=playwright.layout.config.ts
scripts.test:layout:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --config=playwright.layout.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.format: prettier --write src .storybook next.config.ts tests scripts/test-backend.ts scripts/map-library.ts scripts/test-db.mjs scripts/agents scripts/validate-plan.mjs scripts/seal-art.mjs scripts/test-coverage.mjs playwright.config.ts playwright.smoke.config.ts playwright.layout.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src .storybook next.config.ts tests scripts/test-backend.ts scripts/map-library.ts scripts/test-db.mjs scripts/agents scripts/validate-plan.mjs scripts/seal-art.mjs scripts/test-coverage.mjs playwright.config.ts playwright.smoke.config.ts playwright.layout.config.ts
